commands: dotnet test Flowthru.sln --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --settings coverlet.runsettings --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"
reportgenerator "-reports:tests/**/TestResults/**/coverage.cobertura.xml" "-targetdir:CoverageReport" "-reporttypes:Html;Badges" && echo "✓ Consolidated coverage report: CoverageReport/index.html"'
find tests -name TestResults -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
